send.title: Send files with Ferrybox

help.recipients: Up to 50 addresses, separated by commas. To share a link yourself, choose Get a link.
help.expiry: Links last 7 days on Free. On Pro you can choose up to 30 days.

send.done: Sent. We emailed a download link to {{count}} people.

deleteTransfer.title: Delete this transfer?
deleteTransfer.body: The download link stops working at once and the files are deleted for everyone. This frees {{size}} of your storage.

signOut.title: Sign out of Ferrybox?
signOut.body: You can sign in again at any time with your email address.

errors.E_QUOTA_FULL: Your storage is full: you are using all {{allowance}} of your {{plan}} plan. Delete transfers you no longer need under Transfers, or move to Pro for 2 TB.
errors.E_FILE_TOO_LARGE: {{fileName}} is over 20 GB, the largest file Ferrybox can send. Split it into parts of 20 GB or less and send them together.
errors.E_FILE_TYPE_BLOCKED: Ferrybox can't send {{fileName}}: .exe, .bat, .cmd, .scr and .msi files are blocked, even inside a .zip file. Remove it and send the rest.
errors.E_LINK_EXPIRED: This link expired on {{expiredOn}} and its files have been deleted. Ask {{senderName}} to send them again.
errors.E_TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS: This transfer has {{count}} email addresses, and the limit is 50. Send it as several transfers, or choose Get a link and share the link.
errors.E_UPLOAD_500: Something went wrong and {{fileName}} wasn't uploaded.
